chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The hadd is not carried out upon the woman in istiḥāḍah until the blood ceases from her.

key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah, non-menstrual irregular bleeding

ai.seo_question: Is the hadd punishment carried out on a woman in istiḥāḍah before her bleeding stops?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the delay of carrying out the hadd punishment on a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah. It indicates that the punishment is postponed until her bleeding stops, reflecting procedural consideration within Islamic jurisprudence.
